stage: MobileNetV2 protocol Section 4.3 - mandatory validation before the fault campaigns
int_encoding: two's complement; sign = MSB, value bits = the remaining low bits; INT4 packed two per byte, element 2j in the LOW nibble (bits 0-3) of byte j, element 2j+1 in the HIGH nibble; odd count padded with one zero nibble that is never a fault target
